item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong direct evidence that Jokowi lost monetary credibility in 2024 or that Bank Indonesia was overtly politicized. I also did not find a clean, direct 2024 source showing major fiscal profligacy beyond the election/Nusantara spending pressures and the later cancelled tax hike.","evidence":[{"title":"Indonesia Economy Projected to Remain Resilient","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/indonesia-economy-projected-to-remain-resilient","summary":"The World Bank said Indonesia’s robust macroeconomic policy framework helped attract investment, and stressed prudent, credible, transparent macro policy plus fiscal space for social protection and human capital. This is strong positive evidence for macro stability and investment conditions.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.1"]},{"title":"IMF Staff Completes 2024 Article IV Mission to Indonesia","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-06-14","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/14/pr24221-imf-staff-completes-2024-article-iv-mission-to-indonesia","summary":"IMF staff said Indonesia’s outlook remained positive, inflation would stay in target, policy should remain prudent, and the fiscal rule and credibility should be preserved. This is strong evidence for fiscal responsibility and monetary credibility.","question_ids":["5B.3"]},{"title":"Monetary Policy Report - Quarter I 2024","publisher":"Bank Indonesia","date":"2024-04-30","url":"https://www.bi.go.id/en/publikasi/laporan/Pages/Laporan-Kebijakan-Moneter-Triwulan-I-2024.aspx","summary":"Bank Indonesia raised rates preemptively to defend rupiah stability and keep inflation inside the 2.5% ±1% corridor, while using pro-market instruments to attract inflows. This supports a positive finding on monetary credibility and investment conditions.","question_ids":["5B.3"]},{"title":"Bank Indonesia Institutional Report 2024","publisher":"Bank Indonesia","date":"published 2025, covering 2024","url":"https://www.bi.go.id/en/publikasi/laporan/Pages/LKBI-2024.aspx","summary":"BI said 2024 growth reached 5.03%, inflation stayed at 1.57% in December 2024, the rupiah remained under control, reserves were buoyant, and policy coordination with government strengthened. This is strong evidence of macro stability and credible monetary management.","question_ids":["5B.3"]},{"title":"Indonesia books lower-than-expected 2024 fiscal deficit","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2025-01-05","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesias-budget-deficit-in-2024-at-23-of-gdp-3796361","summary":"Reuters reported that Indonesia’s 2024 budget deficit was 2.29% of GDP, below the 3% legal ceiling and below the earlier 2.7% estimate. This is strong positive evidence for fiscal responsibility, though the deficit widened from 2023.","question_ids":["5B.3"]},{"title":"Indonesia launches 'Golden Visa' to lure foreign investors, boost economy","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-07-25","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesia-launches-golden-visa-to-lure-foreign-investors-boost-economy-3535351","summary":"Jokowi launched a long-term visa scheme explicitly to attract foreign investors and boost the economy. This supports a positive reading on long-term investment conditions.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.1"]},{"title":"Indonesia hails Chinese firm as first foreign investor in troubled new capital","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-09-25","url":"https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-hails-chinese-firm-as-first-foreign-investor-in-troubled-new-capital/2283073/","summary":"Jokowi touted the first foreign investment in Nusantara, but the report also said the project had faced delays and weak foreign interest. This is mixed evidence: investment promotion was real, but conditions were not fully healthy.","question_ids":["5B.3"]},{"title":"Analysis: A decade of Jokowi, Indonesia’s democracy icon, leaves illiberal legacy, critics say","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-10-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/","summary":"Reuters said Jokowi left strong growth and infrastructure, but also patronage and dynastic politics. For this lens, the economic-relevant part is that growth/infrastructure outcomes were real, but broader governance quality was weaker than ideal for long-term investment certainty.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.1"]},{"title":"Indonesia says 2024 budget deficit lower than 2.7% of GDP estimate","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2025-01-01","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesia-says-2024-budget-deficit-lower-than-27-of-gdp-estimate-3793456","summary":"Reuters said spending rose more than 6% in 2024 due to election costs, Nusantara construction, and welfare programs. I include it because it supports the investment-conditions side, but it is weaker evidence than the World Bank or IMF.","question_ids":["5B.3"]}]}
